summary: Futures up about 0.6-0.9% after the S&P's worst week since April 2025, led by Dow and megacap AI names (Amazon and Meta on JPMorgan's focus list, AMD upgraded), while Nvidia gaps down about 5% on the board probe of Jensen Huang. Lean long the AI rotation, short Nvidia and post-earnings losers; Tuesday-Thursday CPI/PPI risk ahead. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are pre-market estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Oppenheimer upgrade to Outperform with a $600 target adds to Friday's 11% earnings rally; it is drawing AI-chip money away from Nvidia.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 3% pre-market after JPMorgan added it to its focus list and called for AWS growth above 40%; a hold above $264 targets the $270s.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5% pre-market after the board opened an independent probe into whether CEO Huang was targeted by foreign intelligence; Aletheia cut it to Hold.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up 2.5% pre-market after JPMorgan swapped it into its focus list in place of Alphabet, citing AI ad strength; Friday's close was $610.15.

picks.name: NRG Energy
picks.reason: Up about 5% pre-market on a Q3 beat (adj EPS $4.68 vs $3.36 est.), a $4B asset sale to LS Power and a $1B larger buyback.

picks.name: DraftKings
picks.reason: Downgraded by UBS, Stifel and JPMorgan (targets $21-22) after Friday's 21% drop on an EBITDA guidance cut to fund Predictions spending.
